review_checks: Partner Level +1/+2 is distinct from Partner XP +1/+2.
Solo training raises the named point category; the gain can vary.
All-partner actions raise all partner levels and require a partner.
Coach/Manager instruction has medium/large effects on four main parameters.
All five Boost Week variants last three turns and constrain the named practice type.
Tag Training selects one/two/three partners and reflects overall abilities.
Baseball Dog adds one turn; Fired Up scales with the star count.
Partner Boost excludes custom players and lasts until camp ends.
All four Breakthrough bonuses apply only to the next practice and the listed stat categories.
Invalid Selection preserves the too-many-Specials restriction.
deepl_alternatives_not_copied: Retain Focus rather than Mental: Focus is the official Spirits point-category name.
Retain Pitch Type and Defense as official point-category terms.
Ability Steal is a slot-based special-ability action, not a stolen-base action.
Divine variants obtain abilities from the god, not an ability called God.
Partner actions are not all-pitcher or all-pitch-type actions.
